summary: Software checks cover the preserved research service and the new provisional resource-booking interface. They do not measure planning benefit or real-world cleaning performance.

checks.name: Python tests
checks.shows: The preserved research service, guards, exact research exports, local HTTP routes and source disclosures pass their tests.

checks.name: JavaScript test files
checks.shows: These include 43 functional tests for provisional bookings, transaction storage and booking reports. The subprocess CLI test is skipped in the restricted test environment; direct CLI checks were run separately. Existing research and job-review tests also pass.

checks.name: Manager browser checks
checks.result: Local Chromium flows checked at desktop and phone width
checks.shows: Window area, unknown checks, shared-helper conflicts, later-stage booking, changed-job rechecks, stale-tab reload and simultaneous booking attempts were exercised. Both themes were inspected. Only one of two competing reservations was saved.

checks.name: Manager PDF and exact export
checks.result: Three-page PDF inspected; downloaded exact export replayed
checks.shows: A PDF from three invented test jobs was generated in the browser and its pages inspected. The browser-generated exact file reproduced three assessments with the Node CLI. Altered assessments are refused.

checks.name: Research records
checks.shows: The original research records and decision rules remain byte-identical to the source release. The manager resource-booking demonstration does not change them.

checks.name: Release file check
checks.shows: The local upload folder is recorded in RELEASE_MANIFEST.json. A deployed site and a fresh GitHub download still need checking after publication.

checks.name: Robot card rotation
checks.result: Hover, selection, pause and step changes checked in local Chromium
checks.shows: An unselected hovered robot turns, stops when the pointer leaves, and a selected robot continues without hover. Changing the selected robot stops the previous one. People stay still. Navigation removes the old canvases. Independent source review covered resource cleanup, reduced-motion and hidden-tab handling. This is a visual effect only.

checks.name: Stable team selection and human cards
checks.result: 21 targeted callback checks pass; robot and human choices checked in local Chromium
checks.shows: Changing the selected robot or person keeps all five portraits mounted. Worker plans and existing booking conflicts were checked through the visible controls. Stage changes update availability without replacing the models. Light and dark themes and a 390px viewport were inspected. The UR3 and UR5 square display bases contain the bottom geometry through a full turn. Three booking test files and the isolated motion harness also pass.

checks.name: Optional job duration
checks.result: Seven timing tests passed; local Chromium flow checked
checks.shows: An entered 2 minutes/m² across 24 m² gives 48 minutes. Team changes clear the estimate. Saving, exact export, PDF report text, invalid values and unchanged booking guards are covered. The estimate is a manager assumption, not measured robot performance.

checks.name: Estimated customer bill
checks.result: 12 billing tests passed; targeted local Chromium flow checked
checks.shows: Company-entered rates produce separate robot and helper charges, or one manual charge. Unknown inputs remain incomplete; zero is explicit. Currency and team changes clear rates. Saving/reload and the disabled download for unsaved changes were checked. A one-page estimate was generated as PDF bytes and its rendered layout inspected. The browser automation did not expose the native download event, so a downloaded PDF file was not independently inspected.

notShown: No reliability figure. A count of passing tests is not a measured success rate.
No user study. Nobody outside the team has been timed or observed using this page.
No evidence that planning this way is faster or better than a competent person, and no comparison with another planner.
No safety approval. Answers are declarations, and nobody inspected a building.
No measurement of cleaning. No record here shows how clean any surface ends up.
No job review from real work. The job-review step has only been tried with invented entries.
No live robot. The page cannot connect to, start or stop a robot.
